_doc: Fork registry for PMOVES.AI. Curated list of forks intended for upstream sync. See research/fork-sync-api-reference.md for API docs.

_schema.branch: optional branch override (3rd FORKS column in fork-sync.yml)
_schema.sync: required boolean decision — true means the fork-sync workflow will attempt auto-sync; false means it is explicitly opted out
_schema.reason: required string — why this fork is sync:true or sync:false. Operators read this before changing the decision.
_schema.skip: DEPRECATED — the ratchet gate fails CI if any fork still has this field. Use sync+reason.
_schema._first_party: submodules that are NOT forks (no upstream); declared so the coverage cross-check can tell "no upstream" from "undeclared"

PMOVES-Pipecat.reason: Corrected 2026-09-06; the previous reason was false in both halves. It read 'used as reference, no PMOVES overlay' -- but hardened carries 9 PMOVES commits: integration patterns (1bf8afea), Phase 1 critical bug fixes (0b27fb7e), and a NATS-defaults / CHIT-scope auth alignment (fafeaa85). And sync=false was not being honoured: a12efa49 merged 3541 upstream commits on 2026-08-06. Measured at correction: status=diverged, 1252 behind, 9 ahead; upstream shipped v1.7.0, v1.8.0 and v1.8.1 after that merge. Pipecat is the substrate for flute-gateway, so this is consumed code, not a reference checkout. sync=true, and the merge is NOT a fast-forward -- the 9 local commits must be carried.

PMOVES-mcp-gateway.reason: Docker's official MCP Gateway + docker-mcp CLI plugin. Chosen over the Microsoft McpGateway fork (PMOVES-BotZ-gateway) for the compose fleet because its server entries support type: remote (url/transport_type/headers), so an MCP server that ALREADY RUNS can be federated. The Microsoft one requires ImageName+ImageVersion on every adapter and deploys them via a Kubernetes-only IAdapterDeploymentManager, so it cannot point at an existing endpoint at all. Microsoft's stays for Kubernetes; this is the Docker-substrate gateway. sync=false: PMOVES carries local catalog/config, so upstream merges are a deliberate act.
